publications.title: Document Embeddings for Duplicate Github Issue Detection
publications.shortDescription: Evaluation of document embedding models for issue classification
points: Evaluated 8 document embedding models from the Hugging Face MTEB leaderboard for duplicate Github issue classification.
Conducted extensive literature review of embeddings models for semantic search and retrieval tasks.

publications.title: Cellular Network Optimization with Reinforcement Learning
publications.shortDescription: Application of CMDPs to cellular network optimization
points: Researched the application of Constrained Markov Decision Processes to optimize cellular networks with unknown constraints.
Delivered a presentation to a graduate research class.

publications.title: Compiler Optimization Analysis of the Levenshtein Distance Algorithm
publications.shortDescription: Analysis of GNU compiler optimization using Perf
points: Analyzed GNU compiler optimizations resulting in 35-50% runtime reduction between optimization levels
Conducted experimental evaluation of branch prediction performance across different sequence pair types using the Perf tool
Demonstrated 100-fold improvement in branch prediction for substring and duplicate sequence pairs

publications.title: Restricting The Use of LLM Web Crawlers
publications.shortDescription: Proposal for regulating LLM web crawlers
points: Proposed a convention for regulating LLM web crawlers; similar implementation later adopted by OpenAI.
